description: Creates or updates a subscriber (upsert by email). Additive — does NOT send any email. MailerLite API: POST /subscribers.

fields.description: Custom/default field values keyed by field key, e.g. { name, last_name, company }.

groups.description: Group id strings to add the subscriber to.

status.description: Subscriber status: active | unsubscribed | unconfirmed | bounced | junk.

name: mailerlite_upsert_subscriber
title: Upsert subscriber
